name: t-bridge
description: Collaborative terminal workspace — peer-to-peer remote execution with a modern TUI.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @tbridge/protocol && npm run build --workspace @tbridge/crypto && npm run build --workspace @tbridge/network && npm run build --workspace @tbridge/engine && npm run build --workspace @tbridge/tui && npm run build --workspace @tbridge/relay && npm run build --workspace @tbridge/app
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @tbridge/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace @tbridge/network && npm run typecheck --workspace @tbridge/engine && npm run typecheck --workspace @tbridge/tui && npm run typecheck --workspace @tbridge/relay && npm run typecheck --workspace @tbridge/app
